summary: Fix round 3, keryx server (src/**): all 11 findings of fix3-server.json fixed by the brief's decisions (R3-SC-001, R3-SC-003, R3-AR-004, R3-TP-003, R3-TP-006, R3-LG-004, R3-TP-001, R3-TP-002, R3-LG-005, R3-LG-006, R3-AR-003, with their merged members). The orphan-END walk takes every JSON escape whole and reads the lines above by the END line's own prefix shape instead of a fixed prefix list. In-turn compaction cuts a turn under the 20K tail when the request does not fit. An all-duplicate resend whose notes end the history runs their follow-up turn. Dedupe is by run id and kind. The head line is built and read from one source. 41 tests added; every behaviour test was red on the unfixed source, and every test-gap test is red under a named mutant (one equivalent mutant noted). summary_markdown:
## Behavior changes
1. (model-facing, decided; every redaction consumer) An orphan `-----END … PRIVATE KEY-----` on a serialized line now masks the run before the marker taking every JSON escape whole (`\n` `\r` `\t` `\b` `\f` `\/` `\\` `\uXXXX`) with the base64 around them, and stops at a quote (`\"` included) or any other character: redacted JSON still parses, and a body an encoder wrote with `\/` is masked whole.
2. (model-facing, decided; every redaction consumer) The lines above an orphan END are masked when they carry the END line's own prefix, where only digit runs, the padding spaces before a number and a `:`/`-` beside a number (or ending the prefix) may differ: grep/rg with or without a file name and line number (rg --column `name:27:1:` above `name-25-` context lines included), cat -n/nl across a digit of width, git show/log -p (`-`/`+`), diff (`< `/`> `), docker compose logs, timestamped log lines, keryx's ctx rg items and indentation. A line above with any other prefix ends the mask.
3. (model-facing, narrower than round 2) An unprefixed END no longer masks numbered or indented lines above it, and a prefixed END no longer masks lines with a different prefix (another file's lines, a different indentation); when no line above is masked, the END line's own prefix (its line number) stays visible and only the run and the marker are masked.
4. (model-facing, decided; every in-turn cut, Run results or not) `compactWithFallback` now also cuts inside a turn that fits the 20K tail when the request does not fit: a budget whose cut removes nothing is skipped, the first cut that fits wins, else the smallest cut that removed anything, else the noop.
5. (wire + user_visible, decided) A resend whose every result is already stored, and whose stored notes are the last messages of the history (no keryx line, reply or other message after them), now runs the follow-up turn on those notes (one model call, nothing stored again) and is answered `{stopReason, _meta: {keryx: {terminalResults: {stored: 0, duplicates: [runIds]}}}}`; `/rewind` of that turn takes the notes out with it. Any other all-duplicate prompt keeps today's answer with no turn.
6. (wire + user_visible, decided) Duplicates are found by run id and kind: a final result (exit or signal) after a stored running snapshot of the same run is stored as its own note and its turn runs; a snapshot after a snapshot, or anything after a stored final result, is a duplicate. `duplicates` stays a list of run ids; the kind is read from keryx's own head line.
7. (user_visible, needs desktop-lane check) Because of 6, one session can now hold two notes for one run id (its snapshot, then its final result): `session/load` replays two `_meta.keryx.terminalResult` chunks for that run, and a compaction summary can name both.
8. (no output change) `keryx ctx rg`'s summary item is rendered by `src/lib/rg-summary-item.ts`; the note's head line is built and read from one set of parts in `terminal-note.ts`, and compaction reads a carried head line with `readTerminalNoteHeadLine`.

## For the docs lane
- Spec 3.9.5b redaction paragraph: replace the recognised-prefix list with rule 2 above, and the JSON claim with rule 1; keep in Known limits: a key tail serialized into ONE JSON string with line prefixes inside it (`\n     4\tMIIE…`) masks only the run on the END line, and a space-joined body masks only its last chunk. `> `-quoted lines are now recognised.
- Spec 3.9.5b at-most-once paragraph and AC3/AC9 text: rules 5 and 6. Not re-run: a follow-up turn that keryx's stop cancelled after it was persisted with keryx's continuation line (rule 5's 'otherwise').
- Compaction text ('This changes every in-turn cut'): rule 4 makes it true for a turn under the tail too.

acceptance.criterion: R3-SC-001 (+R3-DG-006) decision 1: on the END's own line every JSON escape is taken whole with base64; stops at a quote or any other character; redacted JSON parses; `\/` and `/` bodies masked whole with the text before the opening quote kept; an escaped backslash before n is no newline escape.
acceptance.evidence: secrets.test.ts: 'R3-SC-001: every JSON escape right before the END…' (\n \r \t \b \f \/ \\ \u0007 \u002B), 'R3-SC-001: a cat -n key tail serialized into JSON, and two END lines in one string…', 'R3-DG-006: a body an encoder wrote with `\/`…', 'R3-TP-003: an escaped backslash before `n`…': all 4 red on the unfixed secrets.ts, green now. Mutants red: drop the \uXXXX branch, drop `/` from the escapes, n/r-only escapes (the round-2 walk), `\\` pairs not body, parity `>= 1`.

acceptance.criterion: R3-SC-003 (+R3-RR-001, R3-DG-007) decision 2: lines above an orphan END are body when they carry the END line's prefix shape (digits and adjacent `:`/`-` may differ); grep/rg with file names, cat -n, git show, diff, compose logs, timestamps, indentation; other prefixes not masked; linear; never past the previous block; comment rewritten.
acceptance.evidence: secrets.test.ts: 15 listing cases (each masks the key lines whole and keeps the line above) + 'a line above whose prefix differs…'. 9 were red on the unfixed code (grep -rn context lines with a path, grep -r/rg without -n, rg --column, git show removed, diff, docker compose, timestamps, header fields in grep context, prefix differs); the rest are pins. Mutants red: no field collapse (rg --column), no padding token (cat -n width), no end separator (grep without -n), digits must match, blank behind the prefix, END prefix ignored (15 red). Frame, cut-line, code-line, JSON-record, YAML, two-key-file cases stay green. Linear: two ratio tests (below). LINE_PREFIX/PEM_BODY_LINE/LINE_PREFIX_ONLY removed; comments on bodyRunStart, prefixShape and orphanBodyStart say what is read.

acceptance.criterion: R3-AR-004 / R3-TP-003 decision 3: a test renders ctx rg items as ctx.ts does (formatter below both, never src/commands from src/security) and asserts a key tail is masked whole; TP-003 cases; secrets.test.ts imports TERMINAL_OUTPUT_CUT_LINE.
acceptance.evidence: New src/lib/rg-summary-item.ts; src/commands/ctx.ts renders its items with it; secrets.test.ts 'R3-SC-003: keryx ctx rg summary items…' builds them with it. TP-003: grep -n and rg -n with/without a path (6 cases), ctx rg items, PGP tail with `=AbCd` (red under 'drop `=?`'), base64 word above Proc-Type (red under the headerSeen mutant), escaped backslash before n (red on old code and under the parity mutant). The cut-line test imports TERMINAL_OUTPUT_CUT_LINE from src/acp/terminal-result.ts.

acceptance.criterion: R3-TP-006 decision 4: the linear-scan test asserts no wall-clock bound.
acceptance.evidence: secrets.test.ts linear test now compares the best of five runs at 500 and 2,000 copies (ratio < 8, 10 ms noise floor), the convention of this directory's pii-linear-time.test.ts; a second ratio test covers prefixed lines. Both turn red under a quadratic mutant (prefix read by splitting the whole input), nothing else does. secrets.test.ts's own older scale tests (timed() < 250) were left as they are.

compact-fallback.test.ts: 3 LG-004 tests red on the unfixed compact.ts (15 x 4,000 turn at fits 8,000; a noop 10K budget skipped; three near-maximum notes under the tail on the 16K window). TP-001 (a) trimmed head keeps nothing older: red under 'drop if (headTrimmed) break' (M18); (b) second-cut shape: red under 'drop && !headTrimmed' (M19). TP-002 (a) fits () => false keeps the full cut: red under 'drop !fits([])' (M21); (b) eight-notes test asserts notes.slice(-2): red under 'halve from a quarter' (M22); (c) smallest cut tried: red under 'return full' (M23). Site 2 'break on a noop budget' and site 1 'noop early return' mutants red.

acceptance.criterion: R3-LG-005 (+R3-HL-002) decision 6: an all-duplicate resend whose notes end the persisted history runs the follow-up turn without storing again, answered with stored: 0 and duplicates; otherwise the no-turn answer.
acceptance.evidence: terminal-result.server.test.ts 'R3-LG-005: …ends with a stored note and no continuation line…' (one model call, one continuation line, the second resend gets the no-turn answer) red on the old server; 'notes followed by keryx's continuation line…' pins the otherwise branch; 'rewinding the resumed turn takes its notes out with it' red on the old server and under the 'archiveIndex unadjusted' mutant. Mutants red: never resume; resumed answer without the duplicates. Pure: terminal-result.test.ts trailingNotesAwaitingTurn.

acceptance.criterion: R3-LG-006 (+R3-PC-001) decision 7: dedupe by run id and kind from keryx's head line; no wire change.
acceptance.evidence: terminal-result.server.test.ts 'R3-LG-006': snapshot then exit → stored, one turn (red on the old server); final then final / final then signal / final then snapshot / snapshot then snapshot → duplicate (pin); mixed batch (red on the old server). Mutant 'dedupe by run id alone' red on both red tests. terminal-result.test.ts: storedTerminalRuns kinds and isStoredTerminalResult table.

acceptance.criterion: R3-AR-003 (+R3-TP-005) decision 8: HEAD_LINE built from the writer's run-id body and OUTCOME_* constants; round trip at TERMINAL_RUN_ID's limit; optional prefix reader for compact.ts.
acceptance.evidence: terminal-note.ts: RUN_ID_BODY feeds TERMINAL_RUN_ID and HEAD_LINE_START; HEAD_OPEN/HEAD_RESULT/HEAD_CLOSE and OUTCOME_* feed both the writer and the reader; readTerminalNoteHeadLine exported and used by compact.ts carriedRunResult (the ']' rule is gone). terminal-note.test.ts 'R3-AR-003/R3-TP-005: every id at the edges of what TERMINAL_RUN_ID accepts…' (probes the validator's longest id and every ASCII character it takes): red under 'validator widened alone' and 'reader capture narrowed alone'.

inTurnCutThatFits: early return only without fits, when fits([]) is false, or for a non-noop full cut that fits; noop budgets skipped; returns the first fitting, else the smallest non-noop, else the noop (R3-LG-004); carriedRunResult uses readTerminalNoteHeadLine (R3-AR-003)
3 LG-004 tests, 2 TP-001 fixtures, 2 TP-002 fixtures, eight-notes test asserts notes.slice(-2)

questions.question: One session can now hold two notes for one run id (its running snapshot, then its final result), so session/load replays two terminalResult chunks for it. Does the desktop's replay need to merge them into one card?
questions.why: Decision 7 stores the final result as its own note. The desktop reducer replaces a live card in place by run id; how it draws two replayed notes with one run id is the desktop lane's (T17) or the docs lane's to check. Not verified here.
